recreation_brief: 1. Set a plain white (#FFFFFF) background with no footer and use one sans-serif family throughout. 2. Place the title 'Adding Ridge Regularizer to the model' across the top (x 15-80%, y 8-18%) as the largest, bold text, in three color runs: 'Adding' #C00000, 'Ridge' #0000FF, 'Regularizer to the model' #C00000. 3. Place 'λ=10' in blue #0000FF at the top right (x 78-90%, y 10-18%). 4. Place a yellow #FFFF00 filled circle at the far top right (x 90-97%, y 4-12%) containing the black number '18'. 5. Band 1 (y 23-38%), left: build a 9-column by 4-row Train table with red #FF0000 borders — top-left label cell 'Train' in white text on blue #0000CC; header cells 'X1','X2','X3','X4','X5','X6','X7','X8' in bold dark green #00B050 on light green #CCFFCC; row labels 'x1','x2','y' in bold black; compact black data: x1 = 1 2 3 4 8 9 10 11; x2 = 1 3 5 6 16 7 5 3; y = 2 4 6 8 16 18 20 22. 6. Band 1: place a blue #0000FF right-pointing arrow from the Train table to the band center. 7. Band 1, center: place a white box with a red #FF0000 border containing 'W' in red #FF0000 followed by the black matrix [[0.13],[1.87],[0.09]], and below it '||W||^2 = 3.5' in blue #0000FF. 8. Band 1: place a second blue #0000FF right arrow from the W box toward the right side. 9. Band 1, right: build a 4-column by 4-row Test table with red #FF0000 borders — label cell 'Test' in white on green #00B050; header cells 'Test1','Test2','Test3' in bold dark green #00B050 on light green #CCFFCC; row labels 'x1','x2','y' in bold black; x1 = 30 40 50 and x2 = 15 20 25 in black; y = 57.4 76.5 95.6 in red #FF0000. 10. Band 2 (y 40-56%), left: Train table with the same structure as step 5, data x1 = 1 2 3 4 8 9 10 30; x2 = 1 3 5 6 16 7 5 3; y = 2 4 30 8 16 18 20 22; fill the x1/X8 cell (value 30) and the y/X3 cell (value 30) yellow #FFFF00 with bold text. 11. Band 2: blue #0000FF right arrow as in step 6. 12. Band 2, center: W box as in step 7 with matrix [[0.54],[0.73],[0.81]] and '||W||^2 = 1.48' in blue #0000FF. 13. Band 2: second blue #0000FF right arrow as in step 8. 14. Band 2, right: Test table as in step 9 with y = 34.6 46.4 57.4 in red #FF0000. 15. Band 2: add a small red #FF0000 pencil-like mark next to the middle Test y value 46.4. 16. Band 3 (y 58-76%), left: Train table as in step 5, data x1 = 1 2 3 4 8 9 10 60; x2 = 1 3 5 6 16 7 5 3; y = 2 4 60 8 16 18 20 22; fill the x1/X8 cell (value 60) and the y/X3 cell (value 60) yellow #FFFF00 with bold text. 17. Band 3: blue #0000FF right arrow as in step 6. 18. Band 3, center: W box as in step 7 with matrix [[0.82],[0.33],[1.1]] and '||W||^2 = 1.92' in blue #0000FF. 19. Band 3: second blue #0000FF right arrow as in step 8. 20. Band 3, right: Test table as in step 9 with y = 26.8 35.4 44.1 in red #FF0000. 21. Final check: three equal-height bands dominate the body, tables and W boxes are similar in scale within each band, the title is the largest text, the slide number is small and secondary, and every value matches verbatim_text exactly.

Mapping of the two blues and two reds to individual elements is inferred: #0000FF → 'Ridge', λ=10, arrows, ||W||^2 lines; #0000CC → Train label cell; #FF0000 → table borders, W box border, red 'W', Test y values, pencil mark; #C00000 → title runs.
